title: Axe 3 · Session 5 — Optimization and generalization in deep networks

p0.description: Opening: a training run that fails in three different ways.

p1.description: The objective: empirical risk minimization, and losses as negative log-likelihoods.

p2.description: Gradients: backpropagation as the chain rule on a computation graph.

p3.description: Optimizers and schedules: SGD with momentum, Adam and AdamW, warm-up and cosine decay.

p4.description: Trainability and regularization: initialization, normalization, residual paths, and the regularization toolbox.

p5.description: Generalization in the over-parameterized regime, a training loop, and a debugging routine.
